41fd5536e9c346b97ad8a18075e1d47fb52397d6.summary: The report, by BleepingComputer, says the ALPHV/BlackCat ransomware gang claimed breaches of loanDepot and Prudential Financial and listed both on its leak site. loanDepot said at least 16.6 million people had personal information stolen. Prudential said a suspected cybercrime group breached its network and stole employee and contractor data, with no evidence yet of customer data theft. The FBI linked ALPHV to over 60 breaches and estimated over $300 million in ransom payments, and the U.S. State Department offered rewards of up to $10 million.
